owner : TEXT (hash of the browser key)
owner : TEXT (hash of the browser key)
kind : emergency | refuse | medical | booking | answer | notsure | human
status : urgent | needs human | answered | closed
bookingTime : string ("" when not a booking)
remote : true (staff browser only: a ticket from another device)
frontdesk.clinic : the clinic file in use on this device
frontdesk.clinic.server : mark, the file came from the server
frontdesk.clinic.own : mark, saved or reset on this device only
frontdesk.msgseen : list of ticket id:reply time (last 300)
frontdesk.notes : map of ticket id to note (never sent)
bot_rules : string[] (sent to the model only)
A ticket and a message are deleted
seven days after they were made.
The clinic file row has no expiry.
